expected_inputs: existing registry and governed source artifacts
new_failure_modes: future incompatible SQLite schema fails closed
changed_failure_modes: bounded repository inventory can resume from indexed scan history instead of monolithic JSON state

existing Living Diagnostics and knowledge-index regression tests
